mediatedEvidenceClass: Real WebView2 port + existing ToolRuntime/Policy/ApprovalGate/GrantIssuer/SecurityAudit; synthetic legacy capability DTO and test-only host authority ceiling solely for wiring, NOT host availability/network proof

outcomeProofs.positive: Real engine counters/checkbox, input/select, key and local history/form; renderer dispatch observed, not promise of remote application correctness
outcomeProofs.preEffect: Wrong action capability/unsupported key rejected with FAILED_NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED and 0 STARTED
outcomeProofs.postStartedUnknown: IPC disconnect induced by Application BrowserActionStarted callback; receipt UNKNOWN, EffectState.UNKNOWN, no no-effect assertion; same-op replay returns cached receipt, not redispatch
outcomeProofs.cancellation: Linked token requested after native STARTED; UNKNOWN, not rollback; unknown mutating chain stopped
outcomeProofs.stale: Native exact node replacement/recreate/disabled/label/href/form action/history/frame and real origin changes; old refs refused; no name/selector rebind

compatibility.waitUnits: Seconds, finite positive ≤ remaining sealed deadline, matches existing adapter
compatibility.pressKeys: Closed whitelist; no host chords/OS commands; exact-node focus proof followed by fixed CDP key dispatch
compatibility.forms: Exact prevalidated field handles; actual form membership and every fingerprint checked, partial/UNKNOWN if a prior field effect makes later target proof insufficient
compatibility.capabilities: INPUT_TEXT cannot target button/password; SELECT_OPTION only eligible select; no transfers/takeover variants

guardRegression: Same installed block03 LaunchingExternalUriScheme handler remains Cancel-first; DOM-triggered mailto canceled and NewWindowRequested handled/denied. No full block03 recertification, no fresh canary registry changes.
authority: C# never issues Policy/Approval/Grant; no reusable tokens or authority in IPC. Model/public selectors/JS/CDP/coordinates not accepted.
quotas: Unchanged BrowserSessionManager1/3/25/10 admission limits; adapter single-session nonblocking action lock rejects incompatible concurrency; no silent action queue
limitations: No actual public network/remote service success claims
Synthetic capability ceiling not certified product discovery
Full observations/actions composition root/tool activation deferred
